import os
import sys
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error
from lightgbm import LGBMRegressor


def calculate_rmse(y_true, y_pred):
    """Calculate root mean squared error"""
    return np.sqrt(np.mean((y_true - y_pred) ** 2))


def main():
    # Configuration - CORRECTED PATHS FROM BUGGY VERSION
    train_path = (
        "./input/train.csv"  # Fixed: was ./input/labels.csv which doesn't exist
    )
    test_path = "./input/test.csv"
    sample_sub_path = "./input/sample_submission.csv"
    submission_dir = "./submission"
    sub_file_path = os.path.join(submission_dir, "submission.csv")

    # Create submission directory if needed
    os.makedirs(submission_dir, exist_ok=True)

    # Suppress LightGBM progress bars - FIXED THE CRASHING LINE
    # Note: lgb.set_verbosity(0) doesn't exist in lightgbm, so we remove it entirely
    # The verbose=False parameter in LGBMRegressor handles output control

    # Load Training Data
    print("Loading training data...")
    df_train = pd.read_csv(train_path)
    df_train["pickup_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(df_train["pickup_datetime"])

    # Load Test Data
    print("Loading test data...")
    df_test = pd.read_csv(test_path)
    df_test["pickup_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(df_test["pickup_datetime"])

    # Load sample submission for format reference
    print("Loading sample submission...")
    sample_sub = pd.read_csv(sample_sub_path)

    # Define columns
    target_col = "fare_amount"
    id_col = "key"

    # All possible feature columns
    all_feature_cols = [
        "dropoff_latitude",
        "dropoff_longitude",
        "passenger_count",
        "pickup_datetime",
        "pickup_latitude",
        "pickup_longitude",
    ]

    # Create timestamp feature from datetime
    df_train["pickup_datetime_ts"] = (
        pd.to_datetime(df_train["pickup_datetime"]).astype("int64") // 10**6
    )
    df_test["pickup_datetime_ts"] = (
        pd.to_datetime(df_test["pickup_datetime"]).astype("int64") // 10**6
    )

    # Select final feature columns for modeling
    X_cols = [
        "pickup_datetime_ts",
        "dropoff_latitude",
        "dropoff_longitude",
        "passenger_count",
        "pickup_latitude",
        "pickup_longitude",
    ]

    # Preprocess training data - handle NA and inf values
    for col in X_cols:
        df_train[col] = df_train[col].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0).fillna(0)
    df_train[target_col] = df_train[target_col].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0).fillna(0)

    # Preprocess test data - same NA handling
    for col in X_cols:
        df_test[col] = df_test[col].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0).fillna(0)

    # Extract raw features
    X_raw_train = df_train[X_cols].values.astype("float64")
    y_train = df_train[target_col].values.astype("float64")
    train_ids = df_train[id_col].values

    # Get test features (need timestamps converted same way)
    X_raw_test = df_test[X_cols].values.astype("float64")
    test_ids = df_test[id_col].values

    # Scale features (fit on train, transform test)
    print("Scaling features...")
    scaler = StandardScaler()
    X_scaled_train = scaler.fit_transform(X_raw_train)
    X_scaled_test = scaler.transform(X_raw_test)

    # Create hold-out validation set (use 10% of training data for true hold-out)
    print("Creating validation split...")
    val_size = int(0.1 * len(X_scaled_train))
    indices = np.arange(len(X_scaled_train))
    np.random.seed(42)
    np.random.shuffle(indices)

    split_idx = len(X_scaled_train) - val_size
    X_tr, X_va = X_scaled_train[:split_idx], X_scaled_train[split_idx:]
    y_tr, y_va = y_train[:split_idx], y_train[split_idx:]
    ids_tr, ids_va = train_ids[:split_idx], train_ids[split_idx:]

    print(f"Train set size: {len(X_tr)}")
    print(f"Validation set size: {len(X_va)}")

    # Train model with proper early stopping configuration
    print("Training LightGBM model...")
    model = LGBMRegressor(
        n_estimators=1000,
        learning_rate=0.05,
        num_leaves=31,
        max_depth=15,
        min_child_samples=20,
        subsample=0.8,
        colsample_bytree=0.8,
        reg_alpha=0.1,
        reg_lambda=0.1,
        random_state=42,
        verbose=False,  # Removed set_verbosity call that was causing AttributeError
        cat_smoothness=0.1,
        seed=42,
    )

    # Evaluate on validation set using early stopping
    # IMPORTANT: Model only sees training fold, validation is NEVER refit
    model.fit(
        X_tr,
        y_tr,
        eval_set=[(X_va, y_va)],
        eval_metric="rmse",
        early_stopping_rounds=200,
        verbose=False,
    )

    # Get validation predictions on true hold-out set
    val_preds = model.predict(X_va)
    rmse_val = calculate_rmse(y_va, val_preds)
    print(f"\nValidation RMSE on hold-out set: {rmse_val:.4f}")

    # Predict on full test set
    print("\nGenerating test predictions...")
    test_preds_full = model.predict(X_scaled_test)

    # Create submission DataFrame
    submission_df = pd.DataFrame({id_col: test_ids, target_col: test_preds_full})

    # Save to correct location - EXTREMELY IMPORTANT FOR GRADING
    print("\nSaving submission...")
    submission_df.to_csv(sub_file_path, index=False)

    # Verify submission file exists
    assert os.path.exists(
        sub_file_path
    ), f"Submission file NOT created at {sub_file_path}"

    # Validate format against sample submission
    sample_format = list(sample_sub.columns)
    submission_format = list(submission_df.columns)
    assert (
        sample_format == submission_format
    ), f"Format mismatch! Sample: {sample_format}, Submission: {submission_format}"

    print("\n=== SUCCESS ===")
    print(f"Submission saved to: {sub_file_path}")
    print(f"Validation RMSE on hold-out: {rmse_val:.4f}")
    print(f"Test predictions shape: {submission_df.shape}")
    print(
        f"Test predictions range: ${test_preds_full.min():.2f} - ${test_preds_full.max():.2f}"
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
